run_sparse_transpose_dense_matmul: run triton_sparse_transpose_dense_matmul to compute sparse.T @ dense with COO-format indices
run_sparse_dense_matmul: run triton_sparse_dense_matmul to compute sparse @ dense reducing along the uncollated dimension
run_dense_dense_sparseout_matmul: run triton_dense_dense_sparseout_matmul to compute dense1 @ dense2 only at specified indices
run_decoder_autograd: run TritonDecoderAutograd forward and backward for sparse autoencoder decoder weight gradients
run_add_mul_inplace: run triton_add_mul_ to perform in-place x += a * b * c on 2D tensors
